name: Feni
description: Goan spirit distilled from cashew apple or coconut toddy — pungent, and an acquired thing.

ayurveda.note: Madya is ushna in a high degree.

histamine.note: Distilled, so lower than wine — but alcohol blocks DAO regardless.

effects.note: Alcohol measurably slows reaction time and narrows attention at ordinary drinking doses, well before intoxication feels subjectively obvious — one of the most consistently replicated findings in pharmacology, and the reason legal drink-driving limits exist at all. A small measure of the cashew or coconut spirit delivers enough to produce it. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
